CALIFORNIA

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPEAKER CARDS

Anyone wishing to speak to the City Council should fill out a speaker card and give that
card to the City Clerk at the staff table prior to the commencement of the meeting. Please
observe a time limit of three (3) minutes when giving your presentation.

PUBLIC COMMENTS ON ITEMS THAT ARE NOT ON THE AGENDA OR ITEMS
LISTED UNDER THE HEADING CONSENT CALENDAR

This time is for members of the public to address the Councilmembers on items that are
not listed on the agenda. Any public comments that cannot be heard within the next 20
minutes will be heard at the end of the meeting. If a member of the public wishes to speak
on a Consent Calendar item, the item will be removed from the Consent Calendar for
separate discussion and to allow the member of the public to speak on the Consent
Calendar item at that time. Under the provisions of the Brown Act, the City Council is
prohibited from taking action on items that are not listed on the agenda, but may refer the
matter to staff or to a subsequent meeting.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

This is the time for general comments, announcements, and requests of staff and/or
other issues of concern to Councilmembers that may briefly be presented at this time.

CITY OF ARTESIA
  ARTESIA CITY HALL, ARTESIA COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  18747 CLARKDALE AVENUE, ARTESIA, CA 90701

  JOINT REGULAR MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL AND THE BOARD OF
  DIRECTORS OF THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE ARTESIA REDEVELOPMENT
  AGENCY

  MONDAY, JANUARY 13, 2020
  7:00 P.M.
The Joint Regular Meeting of the Artesia City Council and the Board of Directors of the
Successor Agency to the Artesia Redevelopment Agency was called to order at 7:00 p.m., on
Monday, January 13, 2020 in the Artesia City Council Chambers by Mayor Ali Taj. The
Invocation was presented by Imam Hafez Hafez, Islamic Shura Council of Southern California,
Greater Huntington Beach Interfaith Council. The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Robert
Gardner of the Artesia Library.

PRESENT:  Ali Taj, Mayor
  Rene Trevino, Mayor Pro Tem
  Melissa Ramoso, Councilmember
  Miguel Canales, Councilmember
  Tony Lima, Councilmember

ALSO PRESENT:  William Rawlings, City Manager
  Christi Hogin, Interim City Attorney
  Ernesto Sanchez, City Clerk
  Jamie Murguia, Assistant City Clerk
  Melissa Burke, Administrative Manager
  Siamlu Cox, Acting Finance Manager
  Danielle Vaars, Accounting Manager
  Boyd Horan, Human Resources Manager
  Rosa Pinuelas, Parks and Recreation Manager
  Edith Guerra, Assistant Parks and Recreation Manager
  Fiona Graham, Planning Manager
  Okina Dor, Planning Director
  Karen Lee, Management Analyst

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER LIMA TO APPROVE THE AGENDA

  MOTION ORDERED BY MAYOR TAJ

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: The Agenda was approved without objection 5-0-0.

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPEAKER CARDS

  City Clerk presented the announcement.

PUBLIC COMMENTS ON ITEMS THAT ARE NOT ON THE AGENDA OR ITEMS LISTED
UNDER THE HEADING CONSENT CALENDAR

  1
   Scott Smith, ABC Unified School District, provided public comments on items not on the
  agenda.

  Viviana Gomez, Assemblywoman Cristina Garcia’s Office, provided public comments on
  items not on the agenda.

CEREMONIAL PRESENTATION

  1. PRESENTATION OF CERTIFICATES OF RECOGNITION TO HOLIDAY DECORATING
  CONTEST WINNERS

  Mayor Taj presented the Holiday Decorating Contest winners with a Certificate of
  Recognition.

BUSINESS PRESENTATIONS

  2. ARTESIA LIBRARY UPDATES

  Library Manager, Robert Gardner, provided an update to the City Council.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

  Councilmember Ramoso provided comments.

  Mayor Pro Tem Trevino provided comments.

  Mayor Taj provided comments.

CONSENT CALENDAR (ITEM NOS. 3-12)

  Councilmember Lima pulled Item Nos. 6 and 7 for discussion.

  Councilmember Ramoso pulled Item Nos. 10, 11, and 12 for discussion.

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER LIMA TO APPROVE THE CONSENT CALENDAR
  WITH THE EXCEPTION OF ITEM NOS. 6, 7, 10, 11, and 12, which were pulled for
  discussion.

  MOTION SECONDED BY MAYOR PRO TEM TREVINO

  Said motion carried (5-0-0) in the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Ramoso, Canales, Lima, Trevino, Taj
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None

ITEM NO. 6 WAS PULLED FOR DISCUSSION

  6. AFFIRMATION OF PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVAL OF CASE NO. 2019-32 AND
  PLANNING COMMISSION RESOLUTION NO. 2019-26P (CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT
  TO ALLOW CHURCH AND RELIGIOUS USE AT 18616 SEINE AVENUE IN THE
  SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL (R-1) ZONE, AND MAKING A DETERMINATION OF
  CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION UNDER CEQA)

  2
   Councilmember Lima provided comments.

  City Manager Rawlings provided brief remarks.

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER LIMA TO APPROVE THE ITEM

  MOTION SECONDED BY MAYOR PRO TEM TREVINO

  City Council Action: The item was approved without objection 5-0-0.

ITEM NO. 7 WAS PULLED FOR DISCUSSION

  7. AFFIRMATION OF PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVAL OF CASE NO. 2019-11 AND
  PLANNING COMMISSION RESOLUTION NO. 2019-11P (VARIANCE TO ALLOW FOR
  A ROOF SLOPE OF LESS THAN 3/12 FOR AN EXISTING REAR “COMMON ROOM”
  ADDITION AT 17916 THORNLAKE AVENUE IN THE SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL
  (R-1) ZONE, AND MAKING A DETERMINATION OF CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION
  UNDER CEQA)

  Councilmember Lima provided comments.

  City Manager Rawlings provided brief remarks.

  At the request of Mayor Taj, Joseph Shih, provided comments to the City Council.

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER LIMA TO REJECT THE ITEM

  Interim City Attorney, Christi Hogin, stated the motion lacked a second, and another
  motion could be put forward.

  MOTION BY MAYOR PRO TEM TREVINO TO APPROVE THE ITEM

  MOTION SECONDED BY COUNCILMEMBER RAMOSO

  Said motion carried (4-1-0) in the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Ramoso, Canales, Trevino, Taj
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Lima
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None

ITEM NO. 10 WAS PULLED FOR DISCUSSION

  10. AMENDMENT AND RESTATEMENT OF PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT
  FOR CIVIL ENGINEERING SUPPORT SERVICES DURING THE CONSTRUCTION
  PHASE OF THE NORWALK BOULEVARD STREET IMPROVEMENT PROJECT
  BETWEEN THE CITY OF ARTESIA AND KIMLEY-HORN

  Councilmember Ramoso requested a Staff Report from City Manager Rawlings.

  City Manager Rawlings provided a Staff Report.

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER RAMOSO TO APPROVE THE ITEM

  3
   MOTION SECONDED BY COUNCILMEMBER CANALES

  City Council Action: The item was approved without objection 5-0-0.

ITEM NO. 11 WAS PULLED FOR DISCUSSION

  11. CONSIDERATION OF ACCEPTANCE AND DONATION OF SURPLUS FIRE ENGINE

  Councilmember Ramoso requested more information about the item from Councilmember
  Canales.

  Councilmember Canales provided remarks.

  City Manager Rawlings provided a Staff Report.

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER RAMOSO TO APPROVE THE ITEM

  MOTION SECONDED BY COUNCILMEMBER CANALES

  City Council Action: The item was approved without objection 5-0-0.

ITEM NO. 12 WAS PULLED FOR DISCUSSION

  12. PROPOSED 2020 PRIORITIES AND UPDATE ON 2019 PRIORITIES

  Councilmember Ramoso requested a Staff Report from City Manager Rawlings.

  City Manager Rawlings provided a Staff Report.

  Councilmember Canales discussed priorities and provided comments.

  Councilmember Ramoso discussed priorities and provided comments.

  Councilmember Lima discussed priorities and provided comments.

  Mayor Pro Tem Trevino discussed priorities and provided comments.

  Mayor Taj asked the City Manager to recap the comments from the Council.

  The City Manager provided a recap and suggested to the Council that the following
  items be added to the 2020 Priorities: Auditing of the downtown businesses, the parking
  structure on Pioneer Boulevard, and the splash pool at Artesia Park. The additions
  would bring the Priorities list from 10 items, to 13 items.

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER RAMOSO TO MOVE THE ITEM, AS AMENDED

  MOTION SECONDED BY COUNCILMEMBER LIMA

  City Council Action: The item was approved without objection 5-0-0.

COUNCILMEMBER/STAFF INFORMATIONAL REPORTING

  13. COUNCILMEMBER’S REPORTING ON EXTERNAL BOARDS AND COMMITTEE
  MEETINGS ATTENDED

  4
   Councilmember Ramoso reported on two Greater Los Angeles County Vector Control
  Board meetings.

  Mayor Pro Tem Trevino reported on the SELACO meeting.

  Mayor Taj reported on the EcoRapid Transit meeting.

 14. COUNCILMEMBER REPORTS ON MEETINGS ATTENDED AT PUBLIC EXPENSE

  Mayor Taj reported on the Contract Cities legislative tour.

 15. CITY MANAGER INFORMATION BRIEF

  City Manager Rawlings provided a report on the following items: The City applied for and
  was awarded a $75,000 CalTrans grant to help study how to improve traffic flow in the
  City and needed maintenance. Negotiations have been concluded with a cell provider
  (federal law now allows cell providers to put a cell tower whether the City wants it or not).
  The cell site will be at the Artesia Town Center, and should generate $360,000 up front
  for the City in non-tax, non-grant, money. In ongoing efforts to improve staff quality and
  bring a variety of skill-sets to the City, the City has brought on Edith Guerra as the Parks
  and Recreation Assistant Manager.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

  Councilmember Lima provided comments.

  Councilmember Ramoso provided comments.

  Mayor Pro Tem Trevino provided comments.

  Mayor Taj provided comments.

ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Taj adjourned the meeting at 8:18 pm.
